At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts across the enterprise, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence. What makes the enterprise different is not the math; it is the operating context: applicable regulatory regimes governs the data, operational pressure governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.

items: The retrieval layer is the moat, not the model
